The Senior Environmental Scientist (Specialist) (SESS) is the Food Safety Education and Training Specialist in the Standardization and Continuous Improvement Unit. The incumbent plans, organizes, coordinates, develops, implements, and evaluates activities to ensure the successful statewide implementation and operation of the Food Safety Education & Training Program. The School of Humanities and Sciences (H&S)

H&S is home to fundamental and applied research, where free, open, and critical inquiry is pursued across disciplines. As the university’s largest school, H&S serves as the foundation of a Stanford undergraduate education no matter which discipline students pursue as a major. Graduate students work alongside world-renowned faculty to pursue and shape foundational research that leads to breakthroughs and discoveries that shed new light on the past, influence the present, and shape the future. Together, faculty and students in H&S engage in inspirational teaching, learning, and research every day.

American Studies, Feminist, Gender, & Sexuality Studies, and Modern Thought & Literature are separate interdisciplinary programs (IDPs) offering both undergraduate and graduate programs of study. Support programs and projects by planning and executing drilling projects, geologic modeling, geophysical well log evaluation and analysis, and subsurface geologic characterization, including underground geologic mapping and logging of drill core and cuttings.

Draft technical reports, presentations, and publications. Present results of geologic/geophysical investigations in papers, project meetings, and conferences. Prepare and defend proposals for additional geologic work.

Experience planning and leading drilling operations for exploration preferred, including experience with borehole design and familiarity with regulatory requirements.

Experience in development/management of geologic framework models preferred. Experience with EarthVision or Datamine preferred.

Ability to execute work in a disciplined manner to demonstrate compliance with laws, codes, orders, and MSTS policies and procedures.

Executes work in a disciplined manner to demonstrate compliance with laws, codes, orders, and MSTS policies and procedures.

Position Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented GIS Technician to support the development, maintenance, and analysis of Geographic Information System (GIS) data. The successful candidate will assist in creating accurate digital maps, maintaining geospatial databases, performing spatial analysis, and supporting departments with mapping and GIS-related projects. This position requires strong technical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Create, edit, and maintain GIS datasets using ESRI ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Enterprise.
Collect, verify, and update spatial and attribute data from field crews, GPS devices, CAD drawings, surveys, and other sources.
Produce high-quality maps, exhibits, and reports for internal departments and public presentations.
Perform quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) on GIS databases.
Support utility, planning, engineering, emergency management, and public works projects through mapping and spatial analysis.
Maintain metadata and documentation for GIS datasets.
Respond to requests for maps, spatial data, and GIS analysis.
Assist with implementing and maintaining GIS standards and best practices.
Troubleshoot GIS data issues and provide technical support to staff.
Stay current with GIS technology, software updates, and industry best practices.

Associate degree in Geographic Information Systems, Geography, Geomatics, Surveying, Computer Science, Environmental Science, or a related field or five years’ experience in the GIS field of work.

Proficiency with ESRI ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, and Microsoft Office.
Knowledge of geodatabases, coordinate systems, projections, and spatial data management.
Familiarity with SQL, Python, or ModelBuilder is a plus.
Ability to interpret engineering drawings, plats, and utility maps.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to prioritize multiple assignments and meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting local government, utilities, transportation, or planning departments.
Familiarity with AutoCAD, FME, or other GIS-related software.
Knowledge of parcel, utility, or infrastructure mapping.

Ability to sit for extended periods while using a computer.
Occasional field work requires walking over uneven terrain.
Ability to lift up to 25 pounds.
Valid North Carolina driver's license or ability to obtain one before employment.

Brite Consulting is a management and technology consulting firm dedicated to delivering value-added services that impact the public and private sectors. We work closely with our clients to optimize their operational needs and provide innovative solutions that help them achieve their missions.

We are a small business with a big heart. We are passionate about helping our clients succeed, and we are committed to providing the highest quality of service. Join us in building a brighter future.

Job Overview:

We are seeking an experienced ADVANA Developer
to join our reporting team. The ideal candidate will have advanced experience in data visualization, analysis, and reporting, with the skills needed to seamlessly transition into our team. In this role, you will leverage ADVANA to build advanced solutions, including complex clusters, and provide critical insights to drive data-driven decision-making.

Responsibilities:

Utilize ADVANA tools to build clusters and other advanced data models.
Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and develop tailored analytics solutions.
Analyze large datasets, identifying trends, anomalies, and actionable insights.
Ensure data quality, accuracy, and integrity across reports and dashboards.
Work closely with other team members to align ADVANA reports with Tableau dashboards and other reporting tools.
Stay current with new features in ADVANA to optimize reporting processes and maximize efficiency.
Present complex findings and data-driven insights to stakeholders in a clear, concise manner.

Qualifications:

3-5 years of experience in data visualization, analytics, or related roles.
Extensive experience developing advanced reports and solutions within the ADVANA platform.
Expertise in building clusters, data models, and other advanced analytics functions.
Strong proficiency with SQL and relational databases.
Experience working with Tableau Server, Tableau Prep, and Microsoft Excel.

Proficiency with MS Office software.

Alpha Omega is seeking a qualified looking for a Data Analyst. In this role, you will manage and analyze quantitative data and provide output in the format requested.

Responsibilities

Conduct analysis and interpretation of data using SAS, R, SPSS
Enter definitions of variables for survey questionnaires, including variable names, range labels, default values, and question strings.
Generate data retrievals and summary outputs.
Support dissemination and reporting of data to stakeholders.
Write SAS programs to generate surveillance reports.
Provide routine analysis and interpretation of data, as well as data entry, coding, and transcription.
Develop presentation graphics, Including MS Office products (PowerPoint, Word, Excel).
Develop SAS programs for managing and validating data.
Review output from the SAS programs, identify problems in the output (to make corrections in the way data are collected)
Review data error logs to ensure that requested data modifications are done according to the protocol.
Identify errors/omissions of variable formats or labels.
Document problems and proposed corrections before finalizing the data set.
Review the data files to document problems and proposed corrections needed to be made to finalize the data set.
Review the quality of the weights as indicated.
Document problems with the SAS program and any proposed corrections needed to finalize the data.
Review the SAS programs generated to create analysis variables for the cycle by comparing the code with similar SAS code known to be valid for creating the variable (e.g., from past cycles or another programmer) or by generating cross-tabulations of the variables comprising the analysis variables.
Merge data from different sources into spreadsheets; conduct necessary steps to ensure quality of the resulting merge.
Assist with developing data management processes and protocols

Three (3) years of experience in generating SAS-based reports using a variety of methods (e.g., PROC REPORT, PROC TABULATE) and exporting those reports to other formats such as Microsoft Excel, PDF, and HTML.
Skill in manipulating and cleaning data using a variety of SAS functions, formats/informats, macros, and procedures.
Demonstrated ability to work with multiple data sources to monitor and assess data to ensure data quality, including accuracy and completeness.
